fields.Name: PostgreSQL
fields.Description: Ingest data from an external PostgreSQL and its wire-compatible engines (Supabase, Neon, Redshift, CockroachDB, Yugabyte, Aurora-PG) via a shared MJ: External Data Sources connection. Schema is discovered at connection time; the connector delegates connectivity to the EDS 'PostgresExternalDriver' driver.

Configuration.note: Bind this connection to a shared 'MJ: External Data Sources' row by setting Configuration.externalDataSourceID on the CompanyIntegration. Host + credentials live on that EDS row (credentials via CredentialEngine); objects/fields are discovered at connection time. Requires @memberjunction/external-data-sources + @memberjunction/external-data-source-postgres >= 5.46.0.
